describe.description: The creature is a large quadrupedal mammal shown in right-facing profile against a plain light background. Its body is covered in dense, long, shaggy brown fur that is darker on the legs and lighter on the muzzle and sides, with a sturdy bear-like build, thick neck, and broad torso. The dorsal surface from the shoulders to the rump is covered by a large, highly glossy, dark reddish-brown beetle-like exoskeleton, and a single large curved horn projects upward from the forehead. The animal stands on four thick legs with clawed paws, with a small furry tail visible at the rear, and its head has a bear-like snout, nose, eyes and small rounded ears.

describe.description: The creature is a bulky four-legged mammal standing in side view facing right. Its entire body, head, legs and short stub tail are covered in thick shaggy brown fur like a bear, with a bear-like head, muzzle, and paws. Its back is covered by a glossy dark reddish-brown two-part beetle carapace, and a long curved glossy dark beetle horn with a small tine rises from its forehead. A row of small round holes runs along the furry flank just below the shell.
